title: Microglial Clearance of Alzheimer’s Amyloid-Beta Obstructed by Nanoplastics
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00291E, Paper
Yue Wang, Gangtoh Huang, Xiufang Liang, Nicholas Andrikopoulos, Huayuan Tang, Feng Ding, Pu Chun Ke, Yuhuan Li
Understanding the neurological impact of nanoplastic exposure has become an area of intensive research recently. This study examined the molecular and cellular mechanisms of how nanoplastics affect amyloid-beta (Aβ) clearance...
